# Synthetic test input; never execute as a workflow.
# YAML comment containing ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }} is outside run.
name: outside-run-fixture
'on': pull_request
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  inspect:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}
        shell: bash
        env:
          PR_TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}
        run: printf '%s\n' 'literal'
